Place: LifeCare Diagnostic Health Centre, Cheras South
Review:

If you drive and are about to arrive at the destination (following Waze or Google Maps), from the main road, turn left and right (LifeCare is already on your left), then look for the parking sign on your right. You will drive down to the car park. Once in the car park, carefully follow the LifeCare signs until you reach the parking area that is the nearest to the entry point that leads to the escalator going up and finally, the lift lobby.
The staff (customer service and medical officers) are pretty professional and helpful. If you are not sure of anything, just ask.
I have had health screening twice in this place.

Place: LifeCare Diagnostic Health Centre, Cheras South
Review:
Extremely disappointing and unacceptable service.
I accompanied my mother for her appointment at 11:10 AM. When we arrived, a Chinese female staff member was conducting training for two Malay female staff members directly at the counter. I understand that staff training is necessary, but training should NOT be carried out at the counter when patients are arriving and require assistance. Patient service should come first during operating hours.
Despite there being no one waiting at the counter, I was still asked to take a queue number and wait. I waited for around 10 minutes. What made it even more ridiculous was that when another man arrived after us, he was not asked to take a queue number at all. So what exactly is the purpose of the queue system if it is not applied consistently?
I would also urge the management to review the CCTV footage from approximately 11:00 AM to 11:30 AM on the day (10/8) of our visit. The footage should clearly show what happened at the counter, including the staff training, the queue-number situation, and how patients were handled.
On top of that, we had a referral letter for my mother, which we handed to the cashier as required. However, when my mother proceeded to the X-ray room, the staff there asked again, “Where is the referral letter?” This clearly shows poor communication between the counter and the X-ray department.
The entire process was poorly organised, inefficient and frustrating. Staff should know the proper workflow and communicate with each other instead of making patients repeatedly provide the same information or documents.
This is a healthcare facility, and patients should not have to suffer because of poor staff coordination and an inefficient system. Management needs to seriously review the staff’s professionalism, training arrangements, queue management and communication between departments.
The service we experienced today was simply unacceptable and needs significant improvement.

Place: LifeCare Diagnostic Health Centre, Cheras South
Review:
Me and my girlfriend walked in to LifeCare Cheras South last Wednesday to inquire about their body checkup packages. We were not sure which package to choose at first, but the consultant doctor was very patient and professional in explaining everything in detail, and helped us pick what was most suitable, no hard selling at all.
Since there weren’t many people that day, we could start the checkup immediately. All the nurses and doctors were very friendly and gentle throughout the whole process. I mentioned that I have a slight issue with dizziness during blood tests, and they were very understanding, they let me lie down for the blood draw and made sure I was comfortable.
After the checkup, the nutritionist also spent time explaining how we can improve our diet in a practical and easy to understand way.
Overall it was a very good experience, clean environment, efficient, friendly, and professional. I will definitely come back here again for future body checkups.

Review:
I explicitly stated before the blood test that I needed the report today. I was assured it would take only three hours, yet by 5 PM, no email had arrived. Upon inquiring again, I was simply told it was 'being processed' and to continue waiting. Ultimately, it is almost 6 PM and I have received nothing! I tried calling, but the office is closed with no customer support available. Is your business solely focused on taking people's money? Will you just say whatever it takes to trick customers?
Update: Received the report at 6:16 PM. They did manage to send the results on the same day, but their time estimation and communication need a lot of work.
I was promised a 3-hour turnaround, but it took much longer. When I followed up late in the afternoon, I was just told to wait, and eventually, the clinic closed leaving me with no customer support. Glad I got the report, but the process was unnecessarily stressful. Don't rely on their promised timeframes if you are in a rush.

Place: LifeCare Diagnostic Health Centre, Cheras South
Review:
I chose LifeCare Cheras Selatan for my health screening because I trusted the company’s professionalism. This was actually my second time purchasing a health screening package from LifeCare.
I purchased two screening packages, including a Women’s Health Package, as I believe preventive healthcare is one of the best investments we can make.
After completing all the tests, I was shocked to discover that the package did not include a Pap Smear (Liquid-Based Cytology), one of the most essential cervical cancer screening tests for women.
What disappointed me most was not just the exclusion of this test, but the fact that it was never clearly explained during the sales process. Had the sales consultant informed me that the Women’s Health Package did not include a Pap Smear, I would have happily paid to add it. Instead, I only found out after completing the entire health screening.
A Women’s Health Package should not create assumptions or confusion. If such an important screening is excluded, customers should be informed clearly before making their purchase. Healthcare is built on trust, transparency, and professional advice, not assumptions.
As a returning customer, I feel very disappointed. This experience has seriously affected my confidence in LifeCare’s sales practices and customer communication.
I hope LifeCare will:
* Clearly explain what is included and excluded in every package.
* Ensure sales consultants proactively inform customers about important women’s health screenings that are not included.
* Focus on helping customers make informed healthcare decisions instead of simply selling packages.
I sincerely hope LifeCare takes this feedback seriously so that future customers will not have the same experience.
My advice to anyone considering a health screening package: Always request the full list of included tests before making payment. Don’t assume that a Women’s Health Package automatically includes a Pap Smear.

I hope maybe 1 doctor can focus to clear the crowd, another 1 can give better and longer service to customers. Or please limit the companion to get doctor consultation. The price offered is considered acceptable.
In overall, it is a good choice for health screening.

Review:
I recently went for the Premium Female Mammogram Health Screening Package at LifeCare, and the entire experience was smooth, efficient, and well organized.
I arrived at the centre at 7:30am, and the registration process was quick and hassle-free. My health screening started promptly at 7:45am, which I really appreciated as it reflected their excellent time management. The staff guided me through each station professionally, and every test was clearly explained, making the overall experience comfortable and stress-free.
Despite the comprehensive number of tests included in the package, I managed to complete all the examinations by 10:30am. The only part that took a little longer was waiting for the blood test laboratory results, which required about three hours to process. However, this was understandable given the detailed analysis involved.
I was able to leave the LifeCare centre by 11:15am, making the entire visit efficient without feeling rushed. The medical staff were courteous, friendly, and attentive throughout the process, and the facilities were clean, comfortable, and well maintained.
Overall, I had a very positive experience at LifeCare. If you're looking for a comprehensive female health screening with an organized workflow, professional staff, and minimal waiting time, I would definitely recommend their Premium Female Mammogram Package.
